The '''Overic Griplink''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It connected [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], via [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]], [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]], and [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].
